text:
Dear Ms. Kahale,

My name is Leilani Akana, and I work full time as a pharmacy technician at the hospital in Hilo. I am applying for the one-bedroom unit because it is close to my job and I love how quiet the neighborhood is.

I earn a steady income, and I have saved enough for the deposit plus two months of rent. I keep a monthly budget and I will set up autopay so the rent is always paid on time. I am a clean, quiet and respectful tenant, and I will take care of the apartment like it is my own home.

My supervisor and my last landlord are both happy to be references. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Leilani Akana

Hello Mr. Rivera,

I am writing about the studio apartment on the second floor. I have worked as an electrician's apprentice for three years, and my income is reliable. The rent is less than a third of my monthly paycheck, so it fits easily in my budget, and I have savings set aside for emergencies.

The location is perfect for me because I can walk to the bus stop and my commute would be short. I am a quiet person who keeps things tidy, and I always respect my neighbors.

I can give you references from my employer and from my current landlord. I appreciate your time, and I hope to hear from you soon.

Best regards,
Makoa Kealoha

note: strong: simple middle-school voice but complete
text:
Aloha Ms. Fong,

My name is Jayden Cruz and I am a cook at a restaurant near the bay. I want to rent your apartment because it is near my work and the neighborhood is really nice.

I have a steady job and I saved money for the deposit. I made a budget so I know I can afford the rent, and I will pay rent on time every month. I am clean and quiet, and I will be a good neighbor.

My manager said she would be a reference for me. Thank you for reading my letter and for thinking about me.

Mahalo,
Jayden Cruz

note: strong: friendly, mentions mālama and references
text:
Dear Property Manager,

I am Noelani Pua, a preschool teacher's aide in Kona, and I would be grateful to be considered for the two-bedroom unit. I grew up in this neighborhood, and living close to my family and my school would make my life much easier.

I have a stable job, a written budget, and savings that cover three months of rent. I plan to pay with autopay on the first of every month. I believe in mālama, so I will keep the unit clean and treat the building and my neighbors with respect.

I would be happy to share references from my principal and a former landlord. Thank you very much for your time.

Warm regards,
Noelani Pua
